subject: LINE clause
notes: kb/Work PB951. 'PLUS and + are synonyms' (ALL FORMATS). The report-writer LINE operand admitted only the WORD, so LINE + 1 was a bare COBOL0001; it now references the ONE fragment reportRelativeSign : PLUSWORD | PLUS, and the golden proves the identity (DE-W with PLUS and DE-S with + print identical lines at identical distances). Format 2 (screen, CobolScreen.g4 screenLineClause) already admitted both tokens; the drift test pins every parser rule naming PLUSWORD to also name PLUS.
